reason: I already DM cafés myself on Instagram and WhatsApp with my rate card, and I can spot a 'pay registration fee' scam on my own. Another app to check every morning isn't worth it unless it actually brings me paid work I can't get myself.
objection: Will cafés near me really send paid invites to someone with 5K followers, or will it just be the same barter offers I already get in my DMs?
would_change_my_mind: Seeing real paid invites with the fee written down from places in my area, e.g. a friend with my follower count getting a few paid deals through it in a month.
